answer.title: Automate Supplier Bill Entry
answer.trigger: A new supplier invoice email arrives from Plumbing World.
steps: Extract the invoice details such as reference number, amount, and supplier name.
Draft a new supplier bill in the accounts system.
Review the drafted bill for accuracy and approve it.
answer.ai_help: Reads the PDF or email body to extract key invoice details like the reference and amount.
answer.human_approval: Emma must review and approve the entered bill in the accounts system before it is saved.
answer.risk_reason: Incorrect financial data entry could lead to accounting errors or double-paying bills.
